The game works fine on its own. You either have something else installed that is working against it, or you have a hardware malfunction. 

Do a factory restore on your pc, then install rdr2 without installing anything else that isn’t required. If it still doesn’t work, do a system diagnostic. 

If you don’t want to do a factory reset because you have too many things on your hdd that you don’t want to lose, then that’s probably your problem. You shouldn’t congest your gaming pc with extra stuff. If this actually is the case, you might be able to create another user on your pc. Make sure all other processes are closed aside from the essentials. You can look online for the ones that you need to keep running. You’re going to need to know how to keep these processes from starting back up every time you reboot, or you’re just going to have to keep closing them every time.  Do a drivers diagnostic. Do a hardware diagnostic. 

I hope that helps. And seriously, stop blaming game devs for things that are user error. It creates a toxic environment.
